# Module capability paths that still decide on the DECLARED ceiling alone, by
# calling moduleGrant directly instead of Service.AuthorizeModuleCapability.
#
# THIS FILE ONLY EVER SHRINKS. A new unrouted path fails
# TestEveryModuleCapabilityPathReReadsLiveAuthority; routing one means deleting
# its line. Adding a line is a decision a reviewer sees, which is the point — it
# makes the remaining work finite and visible rather than a claim in a commit
# message.
#
# Each of these re-reads nothing live, so a narrowing of the principal's envelope
# or a revoked installation does not reach it until its credential expires.
# Condition 1 of the Lane 3 cutover is the work of emptying this file.
